visualReviewMethod: 主担当が元ドットと生成画像を表示して照合。新規の独立エージェントレビューは実施していない。PNG寸法・SHA-256・生成元と保存先の一致を検証。

jobs.name: ブナッコ
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE high-resolution 3:2 landscape four-view reference sheet for ONE existing NIHON QUEST creature. Input1 is the canonical pixel sprite: exact identity, face, main colors, silhouette, anatomy and props. Input2 is ONLY the approved Ringoron sheet for soft matte rounded sculpted 3D game-miniature materials, studio lighting, gray backdrop and layout, NOT apple anatomy. Translate input1 faithfully into simplified rounded 3D forms; no redesign, new ornaments, fur, intricate engraving or sparkles. Four COMPLETE uncropped full bodies in 2x2: TOP LEFT straight FRONT, TOP RIGHT clear 45-degree THREE-QUARTER, BOTTOM LEFT true SIDE facing image RIGHT, BOTTOM RIGHT direct BACK. Same fixed anatomy and same neutral expression/stance in all views. Keep asymmetric parts on the same anatomical side; screen left/right reverses on the back. Correct natural occlusion allowed. Rear has no duplicated face or front-only markings. All silhouettes and props inside quadrant with generous margins, no overlaps. Warm light-gray seamless studio ground, soft upper-left light, small contact shadows. No text, labels, captions, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, borders, arrows, expression strip, evolution montage or unrelated props. This is a visual reference, not a precise mesh or CAD. Identity lock: A friendly little beech-tree spirit, not a pig or owl. Broad bright-green rounded leafy canopy much wider than the narrow light silver-gray tree trunk body. Preserve the sprite's two slim upright WHITE RECTANGULAR eyes with dark inner pupils, pink cheek squares, tiny dark smiling mouth. Two little lateral brown branch-arms with small green leaves, two splayed brown ROOT FEET at the base. Sparse pale bark patches, no human clothes. Canopy is ONE cohesive broad clump, not a giant head with added eyes. Face on trunk only. Modest tree depth and plain bark back; no invented rear face or tail.

visualReview.notes: 銀灰色の幹・大きい緑の樹冠・四角い目・枝腕・茶色い根足を元ドットと照合。背面に顔なし。根の奥行きは未描写面の補完。
